title: A Randomized Permutation Whole-Model Test Heuristic for Self-Validated Ensemble Models (SVEM)
abstract: arXiv:2405.11156v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a heuristic to test the significance of fit of Self-Validated Ensemble Models (SVEM) against the null hypothesis of a constant response. A SVEM model averages predictions from nBoot fits of a model, applied to fractionally weighted bootstraps of the target dataset. It tunes each fit on a validation copy of the training data, utilizing anti-correlated weights for training and validation. The proposed test computes SVEM predictions centered by the response column mean and normalized by the ensemble variability at each of nPoint points spaced throughout the factor space. A reference distribution is constructed by refitting the SVEM model to nPerm randomized permutations of the response column and recording the corresponding standardized predictions at the nPoint points. translated_title: 自验证集成模型（SVEM）的随机置换全模型检验启发式方法
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一种启发式方法，用于检验自验证集成模型（Self-Validated Ensemble Models, SVEM）拟合的显著性，其原假设为响应为常数。SVEM模型对目标数据集的分式加权自助样本进行nBoot次拟合并对其预测取平均。每次拟合都在训练数据的一个验证副本上进行调优，训练权重和验证权重呈反相关。所提出的检验方法在整个因子空间中均匀分布的nPoint个点上，计算以响应列均值为中心、并按集成变异性归一化的SVEM预测值。参考分布的构建方式是：将SVEM模型重新拟合到响应列的nPerm个随机置换上，并记录nPoint个点上相应的标准化预测值。对经过中心化和缩放处理的nPerm × nPoint参考矩阵应用降秩奇异值分解，以计算马氏距离
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机置换的全模型检验启发式方法，通过在多个因子空间点上构建参考分布并利用马氏距离，来检验自验证集成模型（SVEM）拟合相对于常数响应原假设的统计显著性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a randomized permutation whole-model test heuristic that assesses the statistical significance of Self-Validated Ensemble Model (SVEM) fits against the null hypothesis of a constant response, by constructing a reference distribution over points in the factor space and computing Mahalanobis distance.
